findings.desc: The documented /tmp path was rejected on macOS and the validation failure could leave the credential file behind.
A predictable shared-/tmp filename without an exclusive creation procedure left a pre-write symlink disclosure window.
Date parsing accepted timezone-less, coercive, and impossible values instead of enforcing an explicit RFC 3339 boundary.
The evidence bundle did not persist or verify the capture receipt that byte-binds the snapshot TSV.
